component.name: I2P+
component.summary: Router for the I2P anonymous network

description.p: I2P+ is a router: a program that runs on your computer and becomes a participant in the I2P network. It is not a browser, and it does not run inside one. Traffic to and from your machine is encrypted in layers and relayed through other participants' routers, so a destination is addressed inside the network and is never exposed to whoever is on the other end of a connection.

Applications reach the network through the router's proxies. The router console - the tunnel manager, the address book, the plugin manager and the I2P web applications - is served by the router itself as a local web page, which you open in an ordinary browser.
This build carries the router, a Java runtime and everything the console needs, so it runs without installing anything and keeps its configuration in ~/.i2p.
